description.default: T&C Manager validates a completed remediation action. Records Approved or Rejected; a rejection needs notes and returns the action to the adviser. An approval may carry FinalOutcome, RecheckRequired and ChangesAdvice, recorded as the portal does; omitted, the case waits at Awaiting Recheck.
